title: projectOverviewPrivacy
responsibility: Excludes sensitive, removed, ignored, and unnamed tracker items and redacts known credential forms from display text.

inputs.name: sanitizeText.text
inputs.description: The text to inspect before displaying it.

inputs.name: isIncludedItem.item
inputs.description: The tracker item being visited or checked for display.

outputs.name: sanitizeText
outputs.description: Input text with recognised credential text replaced by the redaction marker.

outputs.name: isIncludedItem
outputs.description: Whether the tracker record is eligible for a project card.
